boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's wm_sync.c, 0x020618b8..0x02061d30: 8 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Every body compiles byte-identical with the signatures, locals and statements of ntrtwl/NitroSDK libraries/wm/src/wm_sync.c, apart from this older SDK's WM_SetPortCallback, which builds and delivers no PORT_INIT record, and WM_GetAllowedChannel, which answers 0 before WM_Init.

Order: mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse. The SDK file's order (WM_SetIndCallback, WM_SetPortCallback, WM_ReadStatus, WM_GetMPSendBufferSize, WM_GetMPReceiveBufferSize, WM_ReadMPData, WM_GetAllowedChannel, WM_GetLinkLevel, with the uncalled WM_GetDispersionBeaconPeriod, WM_GetDispersionScanPeriod, WM_GetOtherElements and WM_GetNextTgid absent) is the ROM's order reversed, as in pret's pokediamond WM_sync.s.
The SDK's own sizeof expressions in WM_GetMPReceiveBufferSize (WMMpRecvHeader, WMMpRecvData, WMMpRecvBuf at the public header's layouts) produce the ROM's constants 0x29, 0xc and 0x51.
No data: no function owns .rodata, .data or .bss.
BOTTOM EDGE: the wm_system.c run (src/engine/wm/WM_System.c) ends at 0x020618b8 with WM_Init. TOP EDGE: the wm_standard.c run (src/engine/wm/WM_Standard.c) starts at 0x02061d30.
notes: HAND-BUILT manifest entry, not tools/tubuild.py create output: tu_map does not segment arm9.
Built as C, like the SDK. The prototypes are declared in include/nitro/wm/wm_api.h; WMStatus and the MP receive records are in include/nitro/wm/wm.h.
